open_points.subject: A05-6
open_points.question: What Required tests item must show that a ProofResult is never persisted, rather than merely cached and invalidated when a binding changes?
options: Assert that proving and activating create no persisted ProofResult record and every request recomputes it
Permit a persisted cache that is invalidated when relevant binding status changes
open_points.default_guess: Assert that no ProofResult is persisted and each proof request recomputes it.

open_points.subject: A05 Required test 5
open_points.text: A version refused because its binding is `proposed` is proven after the owner accepts the binding, with the same `flow_version_id`.
open_points.question: Is composition kept with a phase-1 proof failure, or is the version itself refused and therefore not recorded?
options: Keep the version and report an unproven ProofResult until the binding is accepted
Refuse composition and record no version
open_points.default_guess: Keep the version; change the test to say its proof failed because the binding was `proposed`.

witness.initial: Binding B is `proposed`, and flow F has no existing version.
events: An agent composes a flow version whose operation node names B.
outcomes: A05 rule 7 keeps the flow version and returns a phase-1 proof failure; after B is accepted, the same `flow_version_id` can be proven.
Required test 5 can be read as refusing composition, leaving no recorded version with that `flow_version_id` to prove later.
witness.observer: The composing agent and any later inspector of the flow

open_points.subject: A03-1
open_points.text:
A03-1: function_executed -> inside(fresh_bubblewrap_environment)
       environment = {python_stdlib_runtime, code, inputs, exchange_dir, own_proc}
open_points.question: Which Required tests item must demonstrate that every execution gets a fresh bubblewrap environment containing only the listed components, including isolated code, inputs and its own processes, rather than only a fresh exchange directory and the stated mounts?
options: Add a test that distinguishes namespaces and process membership across executions and verifies the complete environment set
Treat a unique exchange directory and mount inspection as sufficient evidence of a fresh complete environment
open_points.default_guess: Add an explicit namespace, process-ownership and complete-environment test.

open_points.subject: A03-3 and A03-4
open_points.text: A03-3: trap_raised -> outcome = sandbox_violation   (even if output conforms)
open_points.question: When an execution records a trap and later reaches the wall deadline or a resource limit, does the unconditional A03-3 implication apply, or does A03-4 precedence make the outcome `timeout` or `resource_exhausted`?
options: Qualify A03-3 so it applies only when neither timeout nor resource exhaustion holds
Make every recorded trap win over timeout and resource exhaustion
open_points.default_guess: Qualify A03-3; retain the precedence in A03-4 and Required test 8.

witness.initial: A function implementation calls `time.time()`, catches the raised exception, and then busy-loops.
events: An agent causes the implementation to execute.
The runner records the clock trap.
The execution exceeds its wall deadline.
outcomes: A03-3 gives `sandbox_violation` because a trap was raised.
A03-4 and Required test 8 give `timeout` because timeout precedes sandbox violation.
witness.observer: The agent or owner reading the TrialExecution or NodeExecution status

open_points.subject: A13-1
open_points.text: A13-1: advance(run) -> inside(start | approve | resolve | resume | startup_recovery)
open_points.question: What Required tests item must show advancement inside `start` and `startup_recovery`, as well as prove that no context outside the complete five-member set can advance a run?
options: Add an A13-1-labelled test covering start, startup recovery and exclusion of every other context
Limit A13-1 to approve, resolve and resume, which Required test 6 currently exercises
open_points.default_guess: Add an A13-1-labelled test covering start and startup recovery and retaining the exclusion between requests.

open_points.subject: A09-3
open_points.text: A09-3: http_without_tls -> instance.class IN {local_dev, disposable_rig} OR loopback(host)
open_points.question: What Required tests item must show the permitted cases—`local_dev`, `disposable_rig`, and a loopback host—rather than only refusal of production HTTP on a non-loopback host?
options: Add positive cases showing that all three allowed alternatives can send over HTTP
Permit implementations to refuse every plain-HTTP target
open_points.default_guess: Add positive tests for both allowed instance classes and for a loopback host.

open_points.subject: Carried to later states / A03 trap table
open_points.text:
Release build: the frozen list of trapped standard-library entry points —
  closed: A03 rule 4 lists them, and the release passes them as data (A20).
open_points.rule: У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: Replace “the release passes them as data” with one of the three specified delivery paths; because this is a closed policy list, name its concrete data-provider symbol as `the imported X constant`.
